items.name: Wood-and-Iron Armor Stand
items.description: A timber and forged-iron display for your chosen equipment. Use to open. Slots from left to right: head, chest, hands, legs, main hand, off hand. Stored equipment keeps its durability and item data.

items.name: Metal Armor Stand
items.description: A steel equipment display for an armory or gun room. Use to open. Slots from left to right: head, chest, hands, legs, main hand, off hand. Stored equipment keeps its durability and item data.

items.name: Wood-and-Iron Wall Weapon Holder
items.description: Mount on a solid wall and use to store and display one weapon. Accepts native weapon items, including compatible modded guns.

items.name: Metal Wall Weapon Holder
items.description: A steel wall mount for one weapon or compatible modded gun. Mount on a solid wall and use to open.

items.name: Wood-and-Iron Wall Weapon Rack
items.description: A timber wall rack that displays three weapons upright at full size. Inventory slots run left to right as you face the rack.

items.name: Metal Wall Gun Rack
items.description: A steel wall rack that displays three weapons upright at full size. Inventory slots run left to right as you face the rack.

storage.visuals: Transient, non-pickup entities; never a second stored item
storage.removal: Native container breaking and drop handling
